compliance_tests.scope: Verify final price displayed pre-submit includes VAT + shipping per Consumer Protection Act truthful-pricing rule; no hidden surcharges added post-confirm.
Consumer Protection Act: refund-timeline disclosure on cancellation (manual OOB) - customer-facing copy and notification must state expected refund window; OOB workflow documented.

Verify PII-redaction rule applied to all log surfaces per pii_inventory[*].masking_rule. Sample-based scan across audit log and notification log; zero leaks for always-masked fields (password, session_token); partial-mask pattern verified for phone/email in non-fulfilment surfaces; address scrubbed from authz_denied payloads.

Verify cross-border-transfer controls when mock-shipping or mock-payment endpoints route through non-Thailand regions. Residency-rule per pii_inventory enforced; transfer events audit-emitted with destination region recorded.

Verify each processing activity (signup, order, review-submit, audit-read, notification-send, review-moderation) is annotated with a lawful basis (consent / contract / legitimate-interest / legal-obligation) and that the record-of-processing-activities export contains all activities.
Verify VAT line-item (7%) is displayed on receipts and order confirmation per Thai Revenue Code requirements for retail e-commerce.
Thai Revenue Code: 5-year accounting record retention for order, payment, audit-log artefacts; verify retention policy on audit rows for order state transitions and admin-cancel reasons.

environments.purpose: End-to-end env for checkout submit and payment callback flows: real order service, real stock reservation, real audit sink, mock PSP.

Deterministic concurrency env for race-condition and TTL-sweep tests; provides clock-control API, lock instrumentation, and barrier-synced parallel submit harness. Required for TC-3-002, TC-3-007, TC-3-008, TC-4-003.

nfr_tests.target: 0 occurrences of PAN/CVV across audit-sink and app-log scans (PCI out-of-scope invariant)

source: re-extracted from output-normalized.json with STORY-3-scoped fixtures + epic-level COMP

expected_assertions.description: P1.stock_available transitions 5 -> 3 (delta -2)
P1.stock_reserved increases by 2
order row created with status='awaiting-payment' and grand_total matching server recompute
order.number matches /^ORD-\d{8}-\d{6}$/ and is unique across DB
order_line snapshot captures price, name, sku at submit time (frozen vs current product fields)
audit_sink contains 'order.created' event with the 7 audit fields (event,actor,ts,before,after,reason,idem_key)

test_cases.scenario_ref: Successful checkout reserves stock and creates order in awaiting-payment

expected_assertions.description: exactly one of {O_C1, O_C2} exists with status='awaiting-payment'; the other does not exist
the losing customer receives a structured error referencing P1 by id; no PII of the winning customer is leaked
P1.stock_available >= 0 at every observed step (no negative reading)
P1.stock_reserved + P1.stock_available + P1.stock_sold == initial total across the race window

test_cases.scenario_ref: Race-resolution on last unit — only one customer wins

expected_assertions.description: exactly one order row exists for idempotency_key='ik-chk-001'; second submit returns existing order_id without DB insert
P1.stock_reserved equals the single-reservation value (not doubled) after replay
second submit response body equals first response (order_id, grand_total, status all identical)
only one 'order.created' audit event is emitted across the two calls (no duplicate)

test_cases.scenario_ref: Idempotent submit against double-click produces one order

expected_assertions.description: audit_sink contains exactly one event with 7 fields enumerated: (1) event=='order.created', (2) actor=='customer:C1', (3) ts is valid ISO-8601 within +/-2s of submit time, (4) before==null, (5) after=={order_id:<uuid>, grand_total:<int>}, (6) reason=='checkout_submit', (7) idem_key matches request header (AP-Q12)
audit payload does NOT contain any of: password, token, card_number, pan, cvv, full_address_line, phone_number (allow-list assertion)
audit event is durably written before the API response is returned (write-before-respond invariant)

test_cases.scenario_ref: Order creation emits audit event with required payload

expected_assertions.description: HTTP 403 (or domain error 'address_not_owned') returned when C1 references address A owned by C2
no order row created; no stock reservation taken; no notification sent
audit event 'authz_denied' emitted with actor='customer:C1', resource='address:A', reason='cross_owner_access'

test_cases.scenario_ref: Address from another customer is rejected

expected_assertions.description: on payment failure signal, stock_reserved decremented and stock_available restored to pre-checkout value (no leak)
order transitions awaiting-payment -> payment-failed; no order row leaks in awaiting-payment indefinitely
audit event 'order.payment_failed' emitted with before.status='awaiting-payment', after.status='payment-failed'
stock_available + stock_reserved + stock_sold conservation holds across the reversal

test_cases.scenario_ref: Payment failure releases reservation (reversibility on checkout-side)

expected_assertions.description: after advancing frozen clock past reservation TTL and running sweep, order moves to 'payment-timeout' and stock_reserved decrements by 2
stock_available restored to original value
audit event 'order.payment_timeout' emitted with reason='reservation_ttl_expired'

test_cases.scenario_ref: Expired reservation TTL sweep releases stock

expected_assertions.description: exactly 3 orders created in awaiting-payment; remaining 2 customers receive structured 'out_of_stock_at_confirm' error
P1.stock_available reaches 0 (not negative) at end of race
no customer-PII fields leak across error responses

test_cases.scenario_ref: Concurrent reservation on multi-unit (5 customers vs stock=3)

expected_assertions.description: submit fails with reason='coupon_expired' or 'coupon_invalid_at_confirm'
no order row created; no stock reservation taken

test_cases.scenario_ref: Server re-validates coupon at submit (consistency with story-2)

expected_assertions.description: 100 sequential order_numbers all match /^ORD-\d{8}-\d{6}$/ and are pairwise distinct

order_numbers are NOT a tight sequential counter visible to client (gaps allowed; not trivially guessable - assert that consecutive order_numbers differ by >1 in at least 5% of samples, or are random within the 6-digit suffix space)

test_data_specs.synthesis_rules: In-memory append-only audit sink with assert helpers for field-by-field event inspection and allow-list scans for forbidden fields (password, token, PAN, CVV).
Synthetic address owned by C1 with non-real phone and address strings; address_id='addr-c1-001'.
Synthetic address owned by C2; used to attempt cross-owner reference from C1.
100 sequential checkout submissions to inspect order_number generation distribution.
Customer C1 with valid cart of P1 qty=2, address A1 owned by C1, optional coupon WELCOME100.
Cart with EXPIRED50 coupon applied at preview; clock advanced past coupon expiry before submit.
Authenticated session for customer C1 with bearer token.
Five distinct synthetic customers C1..C5, each with P1 qty=1 in cart.
Product P1 with stock_available=1 to drive race-resolution test.
Customers C1 and C2 with identical cart state {P1 qty=1}.
Programmatic clock-advance API used by sweep tests; supports advance(seconds) and reset().
Deterministic concurrency harness with controllable thread/coroutine scheduling and lock instrumentation; supports barrier-synced parallel submits.
Coupon 'EXPIRED50' with valid_until=T0-1h (already expired at submit).
Idempotency key 'ik-chk-001' derived from sha256(customer_id+cart_snapshot_hash+frozen_seed='SEED-2026-05-12'); reused across two submit calls.
Mock PSP webhook with outcome='failure', reason_code='declined'.
Static T0 anchor for non-time-dependent tests.
Two-anchor frozen clock; T+10min crosses reservation TTL (assumed; TBD pending OQ-CART-reservation-ttl).
Two-anchor frozen clock for short-window failure tests.
